text:
joel: Proposal: compact timeline on mobile should support horizontal swipe to browse versions, but never trigger a revert. Only preview on swipe, commit via explicit CTA. Fig link: https://figma.com/file/zzzz tanya: Strong +1 for preview-only. Suggest a visible handle and tiny label: 'Swipe to preview'. Avoid 'scrub' in copy. mira: Accessibility: keep keyboard controls and an aria-live announcement for the previewed version. Also ensure interactive chips are >=44px. cal: Implementation note: mobile long-press is flaky. Prefer tap-icon -> reveal inline Confirm pattern (two-step) for revert. That reduces accidental taps. joel: Good. Copy for confirm: 'Revert to this version' in modal; list-level action should read 'Preview'. mira: Color: use neutral/filled badge + an icon for status instead of red/green only. Add visible pattern for colorblind users. cal: Quick snippet for aria-live announce:
// announce when previewed version changes // announce(`Previewing version ${id}`) aria-bot: A11y scan: missing focus styles on small chips flagged; action: bump hit targets and add focus outline. All other checks pass. joel: Thanks team 44d will add the tiny handle and update the figma. Drop any micro-gifs here and I'll iterate.
